Subject: Interest after Onramp — quick demo request

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the great Onramp session this morning — the segment on routing/fallbacks was really useful. I'm Alicia, Head of Integrations at OrionPay. We run transaction reconciliation for mid-market merchants and are exploring ways to add an automated support layer with LLMs.

I'd love a short demo focused on:
- how Redwood routes requests to meet latency SLAs, and
- examples of private deployment options (VPC/on-prem) and access controls.

Do you have 30 minutes this week? We're US-PST based — Tues/Thurs afternoons work best. I attached the event agenda for reference.

Thanks,
Alicia

Hi Alicia — great to meet you virtually, and glad the session was helpful.

I can absolutely run a focused 30-minute demo covering routing, private deployment, and our access controls. Monica (copied) is the AE who usually runs the technical walkthroughs and will join to cover integration specifics.

- Wed Jun 30, 3:00–3:30pm
- Thu Jul 1, 11:00–11:30am
- Thu Jul 1, 4:00–4:30pm

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and we will match. Also, quick ask to help tailor the demo — can you confirm whether you prefer a hosted API pilot or a private (VPC/on-prem) evaluation?
